concerns.text: Consider implementing Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming for conversational responses to further optimize perceived time-to-first-token.
Ensure citation path extraction handles Windows and POSIX path separator normalization uniformly across all catalog documents.
Ensure network timeout errors and HTTP 5xx responses render accessible retry buttons alongside diagnostic error banners.
Confirm component modularity respects cross-epic resource boundaries between shared templates and isolated feature modules.
